name: Santa ga Irutte Shinjiteru?
original_name: サンタがいるって信じてる？
source:
The protagonist believed in Santa Claus until just a few days ago. But when he finally learned that his parents were buying his Christmas presents all this time, he confessed to his childhood friend that he doubted the existence of Santa Claus. Then his childhood friend makes fun of him while laughing hysterically.

On Christmas Eve, someone knocks on the window of the protagonist's room from outside. When he looks to see who it is, the protagonist is surprised to see a female Santa standing there, she tells him that she will give him any present he wants.

The protagonist says, "I want to be the kind of man that my childhood friend won't make fun of".

The female Santa says, "Then I'll make you into a real man", and pushes the protagonist down on the bed...
translation:
直到几天前，主角还相信圣诞老人的存在。但当他最终得知父母一直在给他买圣诞礼物时，他向儿时的朋友坦白，他怀疑圣诞老人的存在。然后他儿时的朋友取笑他，歇斯底里地大笑。

平安夜，有人从外面敲击主角房间的窗户。当他看清是谁时，主角惊讶地发现一位女圣诞老人站在那里，她告诉他，她会给他任何他想要的礼物。

主角说：“我想成为那种青梅竹马不会取笑的男人”。

女圣诞老人说：“那我就让你成为一个真正的男人”，然后把主角推倒在床上……
